def clean_and_order(df, DROP_COLS, order):
    """Drop columns and reorder DataFrame columns."""
    return df.drop(columns=DROP_COLS, errors="ignore")[ORDER]

def get_status_df(df, status):
    return df[df["active_status"] == status].reset_index(drop=True)

DROP_COLS = ["date_accepted", "labels", "editor", "status", "active_status"]
ORDER = ["Name", "Description", "Days Open", "Date Opened","Last Comment", "Last User to Comment", "Issue", "Categories", "eic"]

label_map = {
    "pre-review": [
        "New Submission!",
        "0/pre-review-checks"],
    "seeking editor": ["0/seeking-editor"],
    "seeking reviewers": ["2/seeking-reviewers"],
    "under-review": [
        "1/editor-assigned",
        "3/reviewers-assigned",
        "4/reviews-in-awaiting-changes",
        "5/awaiting-reviewer-response",
    ],
    "accepted-open": ["6/pyOS-approved", "9/joss-approved"],
}

def get_active_status(labels):
    """A function that returns an review status value based on a list of
    label values available in the issue.
    """

    for status, label_list in label_map.items():
        if any(label in labels for label in label_list):
            return status
    return "unknown"

    columns={
        "package_name": "Name",
        "date_opened": "Date Opened",
        "date_closed": "Date Closed",
        "issue_num": "Issue",
        "description": "Description",

        "last_comment_date": "Last Comment",
        "last_comment_user": "Last User to Comment",
    }
)

open_reviews = reviews[reviews["Date Closed"].isna()]
open_reviews.drop(columns=["Date Closed","Unnamed: 0"], inplace=True)

# Issue YAML keeps GitHub's display casing; the board list is lowercase.

editors = editors[editors.str.lower() != "tbd"]

active_editor_counts = (
    editors.str.lower()
    .value_counts()
    .rename_axis("gh_username")
    .reset_index(name="count")
)

```{python}
#| output: false

# Review counts by quarter, 2023-2026 (when funded reviews restarted).
# Current vs emeritus membership comes from the board CSVs. Guest editors
# who are on neither list are omitted from these charts.
YEARS = [str(year) for year in range(2023, 2027)]
QUARTERS = ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]

current_keys = set(
    all_editors["gh_username"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
)
emeritus_keys = set(
    emeritus_editors["gh_username"].dropna().astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
)

# Display names from website contributors.yml; fall back to GitHub username.
_contributor_names = {}
for person in open_yml_file(CONTRIBUTORS_RAW_URL) or []:
    gh = str(person.get("github_username") or "").strip().lower()
    name = str(person.get("name") or "").strip()
    if gh and name:
        _contributor_names[gh] = name


def editor_title(editor):
    return _contributor_names.get(editor, editor)

edits = reviews[["editor", "Name", "Date Opened"]].rename(
    columns={"Date Opened": "Date", "Name": "package_name"}
)
edits = edits[
    edits["editor"].notna() & (edits["editor"].astype(str).str.upper() != "TBD")
]
edits["editor"] = edits["editor"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
edits["Date"] = pd.to_datetime(edits["Date"])
edits["Year"] = edits["Date"].dt.year.astype(str)
edits = edits[edits["Year"].isin(YEARS)]
edits["Quarter"] = "Q" + edits["Date"].dt.quarter.astype(str)


def quarter_counts_for(edits_subset):
    """One row per editor × year × quarter, including zeros."""
    editors = sorted(edits_subset["editor"].unique())
    full_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_product(
        [editors, YEARS, QUARTERS],
        names=["editor", "Year", "Quarter"],
    )
    return (
        edits_subset.groupby(["editor", "Year", "Quarter"])
        .size()
        .reindex(full_index, fill_value=0)
        .reset_index(name="count")
    )


def review_count_by_quarter_fig(df, title):
    # Numeric x so we can label quarters and years on separate rows.
    # Multicategory axes draw year dividers and overlap Q2 with the year.
    editors = sorted(df["editor"].unique(), key=lambda e: editor_title(e).lower())
    titles = [editor_title(e) for e in editors]
    n_cols = 3
    n_rows = max(1, (len(editors) + n_cols - 1) // n_cols)
    n_periods = len(YEARS) * len(QUARTERS)
    tickvals = list(range(n_periods))
    ticktext = QUARTERS * len(YEARS)
    year_centers = [
        i * len(QUARTERS) + (len(QUARTERS) - 1) / 2 for i in range(len(YEARS))
    ]

    fig = make_subplots(
        rows=n_rows,
        cols=n_cols,
        subplot_titles=titles,
        vertical_spacing=0.08,
        horizontal_spacing=0.08,
    )
    for i, editor in enumerate(editors):
        sub = df[df["editor"] == editor].copy()
        sub["Year"] = pd.Categorical(sub["Year"], categories=YEARS, ordered=True)
        sub["Quarter"] = pd.Categorical(
            sub["Quarter"], categories=QUARTERS, ordered=True
        )
        sub = sub.sort_values(["Year", "Quarter"])
        row = i // n_cols + 1
        col = i % n_cols + 1
        fig.add_trace(
            go.Bar(
                x=list(range(n_periods)),
                y=sub["count"].tolist(),
                marker_color="indigo",
                showlegend=False,
                customdata=sub[["Year", "Quarter"]].astype(str).to_numpy(),
                hovertemplate="%{customdata[0]} %{customdata[1]}: %{y}<extra></extra>",
            ),
            row=row,
            col=col,
        )
        axis_num = i + 1
        xref = "x" if axis_num == 1 else f"x{axis_num}"
        yref = "y" if axis_num == 1 else f"y{axis_num}"
        for year, xc in zip(YEARS, year_centers):
            fig.add_annotation(
                x=xc,
                y=-0.22,
                xref=xref,
                yref=f"{yref} domain",
                text=year,
                showarrow=False,
                font=dict(size=10),
                yanchor="top",
            )
    fig.update_xaxes(
        tickvals=tickvals,
        ticktext=ticktext,
        tickfont=dict(size=9),
        title_text="",
        range=[-0.5, n_periods - 0.5],
        showgrid=False,
        zeroline=False,
        ticks="outside",
        ticklen=3,
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        dtick=1,
        tickformat=",d",
        title_text="Review count",
        range=[0, 3],
        zeroline=False,
    )
    fig.update_layout(
        title=title,
        title_font_size=24,
        height=260 * n_rows,
        width=1400,
        margin=dict(t=80, b=40),
        showlegend=False,
        bargap=0.2,
    )
    fig.for_each_annotation(
        lambda a: a.update(font=dict(size=20)) if a.text in titles else a
    )
    return fig


current_quarter_df = quarter_counts_for(edits[edits["editor"].isin(current_keys)])
emeritus_quarter_df = quarter_counts_for(edits[edits["editor"].isin(emeritus_keys)])
```
